authority.scope: record of a blocked adoption; grants nothing

earliest_possible: UNKNOWN_NOT_DATE_BOUND: it waits on US sessions that actually score RISK_ON and STRESS, which no code change can produce.

session_calendar_available.note: The calendar half of the binding exists; the PIT acceptance half does not.

unblocks_when: A US replay population bundle is committed that validates under regime/us_historical_replay_population.validate_population, and
regime.market_scoped_pit_acceptance.evaluate_market_pit_acceptance('US', bundle) returns PIT_ACCEPTED -- which needs all four of RISK_ON, NEUTRAL, RISK_OFF and STRESS observed in the sequence, and
a us_pit_acceptance_record/1 record is committed and bound, with the official session calendar, by a CIO technical adoption (U5).
what_this_does_not_block: The PAPER market-state source binding does not depend on this adoption and does not substitute for it. config/paper_market_state_source_binding_v1.json opens US for sizing from paper_reference.candidate_regime only, and records this weakness explicitly under markets.US.disclosed_weaknesses.
why_ko: 권한은 있으나 묶을 자료가 없다. 이 기록을 CIO_TECHNICAL_ADOPTED 로 만들려면 regime/us_paper_runtime.py 의 load_acceptance() 가 요구하는 US PIT_ACCEPTED 수락 레코드와 그 레코드가 재평가되는 replay population 꾸러미를 묶어야 한다. 저장소에는 둘 다 없고, 있다 해도 통과할 수 없다: 수락 판정은 RISK_ON·NEUTRAL·RISK_OFF·STRESS 네 국면이 모두 관측된 시퀀스를 요구하는데 커밋된 US 점수 이력 20일에는 NEUTRAL 과 RISK_OFF 두 국면만 있다. 없는 자료를 만들어 통과시키는 것은 이 확정이 허가한 범위가 아니다.
why_the_active_path_is_left_absent: Creating the file in any non-CIO_TECHNICAL_ADOPTED state changes nothing about authority -- US stays UNKNOWN either way -- and it makes the producer's diagnostic worse: regime/us_paper_runtime.py currently reports US_PAPER_RUNTIME_ADOPTION_IDENTITY_ABSENT with US_PIT_ACCEPTED_RECORD_UNBOUND and US_OFFICIAL_SESSION_CALENDAR_UNBOUND as its derived reasons, which names the real gap. A file with status CIO_TECHNICAL_PROPOSED would replace that with ADOPTION_IDENTITY_NOT_ACTIVE and force data/latest_us_paper_runtime_decision.json plus a new append-only evidence copy to be rewritten for no gain.
